summary: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026 disclosing that on September 12, 2026 it submitted a Statement of Interest to the FDA seeking a Commissioner's National Priority Voucher for an efficacy supplement to NDA 210607 for ARAKODA (tafenoquine) in babesiosis. The filing cites roughly 83% cure in published relapsing cases and three of three evaluable expanded-access patients cured. A randomized trial's DSMB interim analysis is set for October 1, 2026, with a target sNDA submission of March-April 2027. This is a routine regulatory-update current report, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation. Watch the DSMB readout and CNPV outcome as binary catalysts.
